title: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
wikitext:
The '''Grand Magasin Sisyphe''' is a virtual department store run by N Corp. in District 14 and the main setting of [[Canto X]]: The Gaze Bearing.

== Overview ==
The Sisyphe works as both a prison and a factory. Its delirious customers chase gruesome trends set by its managers, the Giants, and the system harvests their experiences to make N Corp.'s Canned Experiences. When it can no longer produce them, a Liquidation resets the store and erases memories.

== Factions ==
Le Rouge want to draw the Golden Bough's power out of the store's cracks to raise a new god. Le Noir want to keep that power sealed in the walls. Under [[Carmen]]'s influence a third faction, the Néants, appears, spreading Distortions and Abnormalities.

== Fate ==
In Canto X, [[Meursault]] takes the Golden Bough from [[Jeanne]], the store's Architect. The simulation collapses, its 300 million Distorted prisoners are incinerated, and the smoke becomes the Sisyphean Rain over N Corp.
